items.title: New Arrivals From HBX: Moncler
items.summary: Brand Information: Moncler is an Italian luxury brand founded in 1952 by Réné Ramillion in the French alpine village, Monestier-de-Clermont. Over the past six decades, Moncler has cemented itself as a pioneer in the field of functional outerwear. The world-famous outerwear label is especially well-known for its trademark quilted down jackets. In 1968, Moncler designed the professional team uniform for the French alpine skiing team at the Winter Olympics in Grenoble.
